profile.headline: Software Engineer at First American Financial Corporation

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Contributed the development of a several decades old power monitoring tool which uses C#, C++, and Managed C++. The GUI uses a combination of WPF, Telerik, and Silverlight (Silverlight will eventually be phased out in favor of HTML5). I mainly work on the remote client tool which gathers information from the main power monitoring tool and displays graphs and gauges and other monitoring widgets.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Continued the development of a network monitor device and cloud server that the device connected to. Both the device and server were in Python and Django. There was another monitoring device that used PHP, which I also developed for. I also did front end development for the server and web interface for the devices using Javascript and JQuery.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Modified NASA Ames's cockpit situation display for researchers using C++ and MFC. I included functionality to support haptic feedback devices when using the display, and included various force models for researchers to choose from. Researchers performed experiments on the force models and devices to determine the most effective way for pilots to interface with the software.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: LAMP full stack developer for a deals website.
